description: Refresh token rotation: a valid token is exchanged once; unknown, expired, reused or deactivated-owner tokens are refused.

cases.note: UC-01 · BR-09 · Deviation: precondition names capability UserManager, which is not a Capability in code; executed with real capabilities [MeetingCreator, AdminUsers] and the re-read behaviour held.
preconditions: Refresh token T1 is stored for active account organizer@example.com and is not expired or spent.
The account role currently holds capabilities [MeetingCreator, UserManager].
cases.return: SignInResult Success with a new access token carrying the current capabilities [MeetingCreator, UserManager] and a new refresh token T2; T1 is spent (consumed) and T2 is stored for the account.

preconditions: Refresh token T1 is stored for an active account.
An administrator removed a capability from the role after the last sign-in.
cases.return: SignInResult Success whose new access token carries only the capabilities the role holds now (re-read, not copied from the old token).

preconditions: No repository or token store is touched for a blank token.
No repository or token store is touched for a whitespace token.

cases.log: Refresh rejected: token unknown, expired or already used.
preconditions: Token store has no live record of the presented token (unknown, expired or already spent).
cases.return: SignInResult Failure(InvalidCredentials) (MSG01); the token is still presented for consumption so a replay of a spent token is detected by the store.

preconditions: Token store maps the token to an account id that no longer exists in the account store.
cases.return: SignInResult Failure(InvalidCredentials) (MSG01); the token is consumed.

preconditions: Token T1 belongs to an account that was deactivated after sign-in.
The account holds a second live refresh token T9.
cases.return: SignInResult Failure(AccountDeactivated) (MSG02); every refresh token of the account (T1, T9) is revoked and no token is issued.

cases.log: Refresh rejected: token of account {UserId} was spent concurrently.
preconditions: Token T1 is live when read, but another request spends it before this call consumes it.
cases.return: SignInResult Failure(InvalidCredentials) (MSG01): the consume does not return the account id, so no new token is issued.

precondition: Refresh token store and user rows seeded.
